# UX and Evidence Requirements Checklist: Premium Client Portfolio Redesign

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate for the clarity, completeness, and consistency of the portfolio's evidence, interaction, accessibility, responsive, and conversion requirements
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` workflow from the feature context.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the requirement has been reviewed and is sufficiently specified; it does not mean implementation is complete.

## Evidence and Content Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are evidence-source requirements defined for every public project, role, metric, testimonial, asset, and outcome claim? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the status categories for deployed work, assignments, prototypes, in-progress foundations, forks, scaffolds, and learning projects unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §Project Evidence Record]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the conditions that make a project eligible for a primary case study explicit and internally consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004–FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are omission requirements documented for missing portraits, résumés, testimonials, permissions, screenshots, and project destinations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the boundary between demonstrable contribution and unsupported sole-authorship or business-outcome language specified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §Project Evidence Record]

## Information Architecture and Conversion Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the required page order explicit enough to resolve competition between offer, work, capability, activity, and contact content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the primary and secondary first-viewport actions defined with distinct outcomes and priority? [Completeness, User Story 1, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK008 Can the “within two intentional interactions” outcome be measured consistently for keyboard, touch, and pointer users? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the conditions for using an experience timeline versus a working-approach section documented while employment dates remain unresolved? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Assumptions]

## Interaction and Accessibility Requirements

- [ ] CHK010 Are keyboard, touch, focus, and reduced-motion requirements defined for every class of interaction, including navigation, project media, links, and copy feedback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the distinction between purposeful and decorative motion specific enough to guide implementation and review? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, UI Contract §Motion]
- [ ] CHK012 Are hover-equivalent requirements documented for focus and touch without making hidden evidence interaction-dependent? [Consistency, Edge Cases, UI Contract §Project case-study contract]
- [ ] CHK013 Are contrast thresholds and applicable text/control categories stated rather than relying on the phrase “WCAG AA”? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, SC-007]
- [ ] CHK014 Are assistive-technology expectations defined for copy status, collapsed navigation, external-link disclosure, and stale activity state? [Coverage, UI Contract §§Navigation, Contact, Activity]

## Responsive and Failure Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are the required viewport sizes, zoom behavior, overflow boundary, and tap-target expectations documented together without conflicting thresholds? [Consistency, Spec §SC-006, UI Contract §Responsive]
- [ ] CHK016 Are failure requirements complete for GitHub data, project media, clipboard denial, client-side enhancement, and remote-link unavailability? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-015–FR-016]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the dated-fallback requirement clear about source, covered-through date, stale labeling, and claims that must not appear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Data Model §Activity Snapshot]
- [ ] CHK018 Are long titles, labels, and descriptions included as explicit content-boundary scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Performance and Technical Constraint Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Is the performance budget quantified beyond the optional Lighthouse target, including layout shift and critical-path expectations? [Gap, Spec §SC-009, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK020 Are dependency and component-selection constraints specific enough to prevent a second primitive system or duplicate animation implementation? [Clarity, Constitution §IV, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the conditions for deleting existing animation/rendering dependencies separated from the content redesign acceptance criteria? [Consistency, Plan §Delivery Approach, Design Direction §Expected dependency cleanup]

## Scope, Assumptions, and Release Control

- [ ] CHK022 Are current availability, employment history, private-project evidence, and client permissions clearly marked as user-owned confirmations rather than implementation assumptions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 Are out-of-scope CMS, form, analytics, pricing, publishing, and confidential-material boundaries complete and consistent with the contact journey? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope, FR-011]
- [ ] CHK024 Is explicit authorization required at each external state-change boundary—commit, push, pull request, deployment, and disclosure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Constitution §V]

## Notes

- Newly generated items intentionally remain unchecked for reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate lifecycle maintained by Specify and Clarify.
